newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China United in talks to buy JV stake.
newsitem.headline: China United in talks to buy JV stake.

text.p: Gift packaging and property concern China United Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to buy interests in a joint venture in China.
"The company is in negotiation with an independent third party for the acquistion of certain interests in a PRC (People's Republic of China) joint venture company," the company said.
China United said the negotiation was still in progress and the final terms of the deal had not been agreed yet.
"The transaction may or may not involve the issue of new shares in the company," it said.
The company shares were unchanged at HK$0.37 in mid-morning on Friday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
